gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (trimmed p5, printed p9) prints Total expenditures 1,406,963 with a blank Debt Service Fund column; the statement prints that fund's Debt principal payments - long-term debt (180,000) and Debt interest payments (56,113) under Other Financing Sources (Uses) (p6, printed p10). The Debt Service Fund budget schedule (p14) prints the same money as disbursements, total 236,113 (= 180,000 + 56,113), and detail follows the schedule. Detail 1,643,076 = General 445,724 + Street 224,228 + Debt Service 236,113 + Sales Tax 6 + Swimming Pool 111,198 + Cemetery 22,036 + Community Ambulance 469,481 + nonmajor (Park 10,976 + Library 44,931 + Library Board 77,546 + Parks and Recreation Board 837). 1,643,076 - 1,406,963 = 236,113 = the Debt Service schedule disbursements shown as other financing on the statement. Nothing missing or duplicated; no fix.
